notes: Voice Alarm System Amplifier (240W), part of TOA's VM-3000 series. Sold in region variants: VM-3240VA AMQ (North America, confirmed 120V AC/60Hz per toaelectronics.com/en-us/products/detail/vm3240vaamq) and VM-3240VA CE / CE-GB (Europe, ships with Schuko or UK mains plug per the CE datasheet's rear-view drawing). Oddly, the CE datasheet's own spec table lists "Power Source: 120 V AC, 60 Hz" identical to the AMQ variant, which looks like a copy/paste artifact rather than the true EU rating (~220-240V/50Hz) — flagged, not independently confirmed; port set below reflects the CE datasheet (toa.co.in), which is the most complete connector-level source found. AC inlet type is inferred as IEC (C13/C14) because a detachable "Power cable (2 m)" is listed as an included accessory rather than a captive cord; exact IEC sub-type not stated. RM Link, VM Link, EXT PA Link, DS Link, and Emergency Control are proprietary TOA control/audio-link buses carried over RJ45/CAT5-STP cable, not standard data Ethernet, so no bandwidth grade is set for them (only the Network I/F "LAN" port is graded, as 10BASE-T/100BASE-TX = eth-100m). RM Link is documented as "Input 1-2" in one spec row; modeled here as two physical RJ45 jacks (RM LINK 1/2) by analogy with the numbered XLR inputs, not independently confirmed via a rear-panel photo. Emergency Control is documented as three signal groups (Inputs 1-5, Input 6, Status-out relay) all listed as "RJ45 female connector"; modeled here as a single combined port since the datasheet doesn't unambiguously state whether these share one jack or use separate ones. DC-power terminal ports (POWER IN, PS OUT, DC24V OUT) are M4 screw-terminal blocks per the spec sheet, mapped to the closest available id "euroblock-dc". Speaker outputs 1-2 are rated 240W max each and 3-6 at 120W max each, but total combined output across all six is capped at 240W. Secondary corroborating sources: TOA US product page (toaelectronics.com/en-us/products/detail/vm3240vaamq) and B&H Photo listing (bhphotovideo.com, model VM-3240VA AMQ).
